conversation_history.user_query: 列出每个学校的名称和平均阅读成绩
conversation_history.final_sql: SELECT T1.School, AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read_score FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds GROUP BY T1.School ORDER BY avg_read_score DESC
